title: Investment Research Brief (light contract)
description: Written by the orchestrator after sector_config + market_context, before Phase 0 fan-out. North star for coverage of investment questions. Optional on legacy sessions (absent → SKIPPED in checks).

investment_objective.description: Why this research run exists (initiate, update, stress governance, etc.).

must_answer_questions.description: Investment questions Phase 0–2 must cover or explicitly leave open.

listing.description: Exchange / filing venue hints mirrored from market_context when useful.

out_of_scope.description: Topics deliberately not pursued (prevent thrashing, not strip quality work).

research_depth.description: standard = full gates, typical intensity low; deep = extra ownership/FX/control/primary work. Never skip deep dive or stress≥5.

rationale.description: Why this research_depth and question set for this name.

stop_criteria.description: Optional done-when signals (e.g. scorecard graded, ≥3 annuals on disk).
